channels.dmLeave.confirmBody: The conversation so far disappears from your screen. It stays as it is on {name}'s screen.
channels.dmLeave.confirmRevive: If a new message arrives, it starts a new conversation from that message.
channels.dmLeave.confirmFinal: You can't undo this after you leave.
channels.dmLeave.confirmScheduled: {count, plural, one {# scheduled message will also be canceled.} other {# scheduled messages will also be canceled.}}
channels.nameRule.tooLong: Channel names can be up to {max, number} characters.
channels.nameRule.hidden: The name contains invisible characters. Clear it and type the name again.
channels.nameRule.unsupported: Use only letters, numbers, hyphens (-) and underscores (_).
channels.nameRule.edge: The name must start and end with a letter or number. Hyphens and underscores can only go in the middle.
channels.nameRule.serverRejected: The server did not accept this name. Use only letters, numbers, - and _.
